notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.58.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Sua loi ban 2.0.57: nhan nut tren ribbon ghi nham "Mat dung chinh", da sua thanh "Mat bang chinh". - Tu dat ky hieu cua di, cua so (tham so type 9C01-KY HIEU CUA) theo quy tac HPCONS: nhom theo tien to ten type (D0, Df, Dr, Drf, De / W0, Ww, WL, WM, WF, WG, WCL; ten type khong co tien to thi lay o ten family), ma = tien to + so (D01, Df1...). Chi dat cho type chua co ky hieu dung dang; ky hieu dung dang duoc giu nguyen. - Ten type cua tu cap nhat theo ky hieu + kich thuoc: <ky hieu>-<rong>x<cao> (vd D01-3000x3000). Cac cua cung type ma khac
